verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents nix-shell, nix develop, flakes commands, and NixOS configuration, but never mentions Nix's flake.lock file or any lockfile format, its structure, its being text-based/JSON, or guidance on reading/diffing it. Without any citation describing a documented, agent-readable lockfile, this axis is unsupported even though it plausibly applies to a package manager like Nix.
